title: Existence of a non-quadratic crooked APN function
summary: Determine whether any crooked APN function exists that is not quadratic.

formal_statement.body: Does there exist a positive integer $n$ and a non-quadratic APN function $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$ that is crooked, meaning that for every $a\ne 0$ the derivative image $\{F(x+a)+F(x):x\in\mathbb F_2^n\}$ is an affine hyperplane? Construct one such function or prove that every crooked function is quadratic.

scope.domain: Crooked and almost perfect nonlinear vectorial Boolean functions
assumptions: F : F_2^n -> F_2^n for some positive integer n
Every nonzero derivative image of F is an affine hyperplane
scope.unresolved_remainder: No non-quadratic crooked APN witness is known in the audited literature, and no theorem proves that all crooked functions are quadratic.

citations.label: Beneteau--Goluboff--Kolsch--Vaghasiya, Walsh spectra of quadratic APN functions

progress.summary: The source records that no crooked non-quadratic function is known, leaving a precise existence question.
